req.title: Empty player list returns empty array
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players when the table is empty with HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array.
triggers: empty player list returns empty array

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-025 requires GET /players/ to return HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array when the player table is empty. Three test cases are designed: (1) a positive EP test confirming the nominal empty-table response, (2) a boundary BVA test verifying the exact transition from zero rows to one row (the boundary between empty and non-empty), and (3) a negative NEG test confirming that a wrong HTTP method (POST without body) returns a client error (4xx), not 200. All tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, mock the database session dependency to control table state precisely, and assert exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

preconditions: Cache is cleared before the request

expected: Response body is exactly the JSON empty array []
trace: R-PLAYER-025: HTTP 200 + empty array when table is empty
tests.executable:
import asyncio
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from main import app
from databases.player_database import Base, generate_async_session
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache

DSN = "sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:"
_engine = create_async_engine(DSN, future=True)
_SessionLocal = sessionmaker(_engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

async def _setup():
    async with _engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    await simple_memory_cache.clear()

asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_setup())

async def _override():
    async with _SessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _override

def test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/players/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == []
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]

test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import asyncio
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from main import app
from databases.player_database import Base, generate_async_session
from schemas.player_schema import Player
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache

DSN2 = "sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:"
_engine2 = create_async_engine(DSN2, future=True)
_SL2 = sessionmaker(_engine2, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

async def _setup2():
    async with _engine2.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    await simple_memory_cache.clear()

asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_setup2())

async def _override2():
    async with _SL2() as session:
        yield session

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _override2

def test_get_players_boundary_zero_vs_one_row():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r0 = client.get("/players/")
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    assert r0.json() == []
    async def _insert():
        async with _SL2() as s:
            p = Player(first_name="Test", last_name="Player",
                       squad_number=99, position="Goalkeeper")
            s.add(p)
            await s.commit()
        await simple_memory_cache.clear()
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_insert())
    r1 = client.get("/players/")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    body = r1.json()
    assert len(body) == 1
    assert body[0]["squadNumber"] == 99

test_get_players_boundary_zero_vs_one_row()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import asyncio
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from main import app
from databases.player_database import Base, generate_async_session
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache

DSN3 = "sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:"
_engine3 = create_async_engine(DSN3, future=True)
_SL3 = sessionmaker(_engine3, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

async def _setup3():
    async with _engine3.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    await simple_memory_cache.clear()

asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_setup3())

async def _override3():
    async with _SL3() as session:
        yield session

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _override3

def test_get_players_wrong_method_returns_4xx_not_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.post("/players/", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.status_code != 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert body != []
